sloka: अश्वपृष्ठे रथे नागे खड्गे धनुषि कर्षणे।भेदे सान्त्वे च दाने च नये मन्त्रे च सम्मतः ।। ६.७१.२९ ।।
transliteration: aśvapṛṣṭhe rathe nāge khaḍge dhanuṣi karṣaṇe।bhede sāntve ca dāne ca naye mantre ca sammataḥ ।। 6.71.29 ।।

translations.english: "He is best in riding on horseback, on elephant back and in the use of sword and bow. He is capable of sowing dissension, making peace, giving charity and statecraft."
